method_limits: The literal source/geometry/identity inspection is independent. Original global raster results and physical results are reused, not rerun.
The old source census covers its pinned 368-product corpus only; it is not an exhaustive inventory of every later or external geographic source.
Shapely point probes consume retained rounded longitude/latitude values; they are source-geography diagnostics, not the exact native rational grid predicate.
Complete actual current country/fine-source competition, native boundary ties, occupied keys and predecessor conservation are not established by this source assessment.
The complete raw physical result was not locally available; this assessment verifies the immutable public independent review/execution view only, without manufacturing a qualified receipt.

Stable owner indices are independently matched against the pinned original complete source roster. This source read is not a separate verification of every current cumulative native owner-roster entry.
